acknowledged.prop:one-cell-calibration: A delivered benchmark that checks the phase exponents in an explicit one-stratum model and is discussed in the main statistical-results section.
acknowledged.thm:causal-frontier-lift: A delivered headline result transporting the observed minimax-risk and honest-length frontiers to the declared full-data causal class.
acknowledged.thm:continuity-only-frontier: A delivered headline result establishing the separate continuity-only frontier and elbow, not literature motivation.
acknowledged.def:continuity-frontier: The rate definition used by the delivered continuity-only headline theorem.
acknowledged.def:continuity-fallback-estimator: The constructive estimator used to attain the upper side of the delivered continuity-only frontier.
acknowledged.def:continuity-honest-interval: The constructive interval used to attain the honest-length upper side of the delivered continuity-only frontier.
